candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) when _owner is zero, otherwise return _owner (introduces conditional different return behavior).
Removed the require that newOwner != address(0), allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero address.
Added an extra requirement that newOwner must not be the current owner, preventing no-op ownership transfers to same address.
Changed visibility from public to external, altering how transferOwnership can be called (still callable externally but different ABI/internal call behavior).
Weakened onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing who is authorized to call transferOwnership.
Change paused() to always return true (overrides internal _paused state).
Change setKeeper to only allow non-zero new owner by requiring new keeper != address(0) before assignment (prevents setting keeper to zero address).
Change setKeeper to assign keeper to msg.sender instead of the provided _keeper (so keeper becomes caller, not argument).
Change setKeeper to emit previous keeper in event and do not change state (remove assignment) so keeper remains unchanged after call.
Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove owner check) so setKeeper can be called by non-owner and thus change keeper by different callers.
